title: SoFi Stadium
visualBrief: Specific SoFi Stadium connected canopy complex: native swept fish-shaped pale rim and closed gently domed ETFE-panel roof, visible underside/grid beams/branched perimeter columns, sunken blue-gray stepped bowl/four seating bands/suites/radial aisles, retaining walls/closed football floor/neutral linework/goals, hollow double-sided oval suspended display and hangers, open concourses/major entries/stair-escalator groups, covered plaza and attached mapped theater exterior. Five existing shared concrete/paint/fritted-glass/window-grid/canvas graphs. No copied team/sponsor/live-screen text, crowd/event setup, furnished service/theater interior, neighboring NFL office, parking/lake mesh or whole-site slab.
